# Jonathan Orlowski

> MLOps-oriented software engineer with 10+ years in business intelligence. Builds and deploys ML, full-stack and IoT projects, self-hosted on two VPSes with Docker, Caddy, Postgres and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.

Born in Argentina, based between London and Kampala. Email is the best way to get in touch: hello@jonathan-orlowski.dev.

## AI/ML projects

- [Agentic News-to-Image](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/agentic-ai-news-to-image/): an n8n agent picks the day's most important headline, avoiding its last ten picks, and has Flux.1 Schnell render it; Gemini Flash with GPT-OSS 120B on Groq as fallback. Web page and Android app. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/agentic-ai-news-to-image
- [Voice Clone](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/voice-clone/): Argentinean Spanish in a cloned voice, from Coqui XTTS v2 fine-tuned on a local GPU, with a web demo and an Android app. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/voice-clone and https://github.com/jonorl/voice-clone-mobile
- [Fugazzeta Detector](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/fugazzeta/): pizza classifier, a convnext_tiny fine-tuned with fastai and served by Gradio/FastAPI. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/fugazzeta

## Real-world problems

- [Air Quality Monitor (IoT)](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/pollution/): Rust firmware on an ESP32-S3 posts particle readings to a Fastify/Prisma API; a three.js dashboard draws them live on the web and Android. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/pollution
- [NordVPN on a webOS TV](https://github.com/jonorl/NordVPN-WebOS): split tunnelling for one device over WireGuard on an Asuswrt-Merlin router, with a kill switch, a failover watchdog and a TV app to pick or rotate servers.

## Client work

- [Teatro Dislocador](https://teatrodislocador.ar): live site for an independent theatre in Comodoro Rivadavia, Argentina, with a public site, an admin CMS and a Postgres/Prisma API; n8n and Gemini turn its Instagram posts into listings. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/teatro-dislocador

## Just for fun

- [Where in the World?](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/carmen): the 1990 detective game remade in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly, with family and friends as the thieves, in English or Spanish. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/carmen
